answer: Each AI agent must escrow a token‑bond equal to the “pigment” fee before it can publish a kernel of work to the network, and the bond is locked for a meadow‑length window of 48 hours. If a validator later proves the identity is duplicate, the escrow is clawed back and redistributed, forcing the attacker to forfeit the full bond per fake identity. Thus the attacker’s cost is the entire escrow amount—​e.g. 10 tokens locked and lost for every sybil created.
